lastCompletedStory.title: Bound Dashboard composed frame height to pane rows to stop 'Loop' header ghosting

nextStoryContext: The top-level Box in DashboardApp (src/ui/Dashboard.tsx:276) now has height={rows} destructured from useWindowSize, with flexShrink={0} wrappers around SummaryPanel/list-mode/detail-mode content so Ink measures a stable frame height and reconciles in place on steady same-width poll ticks instead of re-emitting the whole frame (which stacked the 'Loop' header once per tick). Verified empirically: ran `bun index.ts dashboard` in a real 60x18 tmux pane across 3 poll ticks (2s interval) - frame stayed exactly 18 lines each capture, 'Loop' text count stayed constant at 2 (heading + story-title substring), no stacking. In ink-testing-library's fake Stdout, `rows` is undefined (no getter on the fake, only `columns`), so Ink's getWindowSize() falls back through terminalSize() to the hardcoded default of 24 - tests that assert `frame.split('\n').length <= 24` are relying on that fallback, not a real pane height; keep that in mind if a future story tries to drive a real rows value through ink-testing-library (same limitation already documented in patterns.md for `columns`). makePollWidthClearer (width-gated clear-on-change logic) was left untouched per AC2 - do not fold rows into that clearer, height-bounding and width-change-clearing are separate mechanisms that happen to cooperate.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed useWindowSize() returns {columns, rows} and Box height accepts a number; implementation matches current Ink 7 docs.
